text.analysis.mjs: turns a delegate run's calls into tokens, USD and tool-output tokens per phase, per tool and per agent, plus the pass result from the last review verdict of either reviewer type
text.baseline.mjs: builds, validates and compares the versioned baseline file, and refuses to compare files made with different estimators
text.phases.mjs: decides which of brief, work, review or handover each call belongs to from the tools it invokes and the agent type (both reviewer types are review), treating a run of the configured skill linker as neutral
text.phases.mjs < skills/lantern-delegate/scr: names the reviewer agent types whose calls and spawns count as review
tells the configured skill linker's own commands apart
text.phases.mjs gotcha: a call with only neutral tools keeps the previous phase, and a compound command is neutral only when every part is
text.prices.mjs: list prices per model and the USD of one call from its transcript usage, with 5 minute and 1 hour cache writes priced apart
text.prices.mjs gotcha: a model missing from the table counts 0 USD and is reported as an unpriced call
text.render.mjs: prints one baseline as the per-phase, per-tool and per-agent text report, naming the estimators used
text.run.mjs < skills/lantern-delegate/script: finds the configured skill linker to pass into the analysis
text.run.mjs: run-cost command entry: prints a run's phase table, writes a baseline with --out, or compares two baselines and exits 1 when the pass result differs
text.transcripts.mjs: reads agent transcripts and meta files from one directory, finds reviewers through parentAgentId and sums tool_result text at bytes/4
text.transcripts.mjs gotcha: reads only plain files inside the given directory and skips symlinks, so a planted link cannot pull in other files
